text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is this...?! A flame-like 
vitality, as if a volcano has erupted 
inside my body...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
O Three Goddesses... Could it truly be 
that you were the ones who bestowed this 
power upon me...!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Either way... I shall surely deliver a run 
worthy of this power. —Bear witness!!
